title: PURSUE Release 4 - official record index (all 40 records: documents, videos, images, audio)
doc_notes: This document is an official index of 40 declassified UAP records from the Department of War, containing one specific report of an occupant-like phenomenon.

encounters.summary: A U.S. military operator reported observing an object described as a maroonish, deformed balloon-like phenomenon, 12-15 feet in height, traveling with the wind.
encounters.entity_appearance: darker, maroonish color, somewhat deformed balloon
encounters.quote: darker, maroonish color, approximately 12-15 feet in height
